name: @a11y-agent-team/mcp-server
description: Server-based MCP server for the A11y Agent Team. Provides accessibility scanning tools over stdio and over the Streamable HTTP transport. Works with any MCP client.

scripts.build: esbuild stdio.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --legal-comments=eof --external:playwright --external:playwright-core --external:@axe-core/playwright --external:pdf-lib "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __a11yRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __a11yRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/stdio.mjs

//overrides: Transitive dependencies pinned to their first patched release. Each is within the range its parent asks for, so this raises a floor rather than forcing an incompatible version. Remove an entry once the parent ships a range that cannot resolve below it.
